FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 99 Cont.
Mar. 14 Mrs. Florence Bernier - 61 - married 40 yrs. Husband very irreli- gious. Mrs. A. Dugan - 45 - goiter & heart Lillian Saunders - 30 - 11
Page 100
Mar. 14 Mrs. & Mrs. B. J. Millis - over 70 - Husband away - not doing right wants him home.
YYvomae Rheault - 35 - 2 little children & husband ... very serious kidney trouble
E'd McCann - 17 - threatened with loss of Eye, piece of cement Sam Serra - 42 - anxious
Ruth Mary Woodruff - 15 - seriasus "no cure" - Mother has goitre & sinus & tuomers - father non Catholic - not prejudiced - listens to Fr. Coughlin ....
Mary Johnson .... Thanksgiving - Escapes .... Cancer ... . !!..
Mrs. Barbara Kusmierz - 28 - husband in angry broke her neck ... has daughter 15 yr. old - 5 yrs. now.
Page 101 Mar. 18 Mrs. J. Hughes - 56 - glucomic Eye. . other threatened ... five Drs. wanted to remove it ....
19 Martin Tighe - 50 - tinker
Dr. McHugh ..... drink.
20 "Why Purgatory" rather "Why do Catholics believe in Purgatory?" % phone .
Mrs. Mary A. Conroy - 85 - for grace of a Happy death.
